verdict.rationale: Firebase ships an official CLI (firebase-tools) that deploys code and assets to projects, interacts with database data, and imports/exports Auth users. It also offers `login:ci` tokens for non-interactive environments, and its official MCP server lets agents create and manage projects, manage Auth users, and work with Firestore data. However, the evidence never explicitly shows the CLI deploying Security Rules or configuring auth providers, and schema generation is documented only via Gemini in the console. Missing for 10: explicit CLI deployment of Security Rules/policies, headless auth-provider configuration, scripted schema/index provisioning, hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end scripted backend setup.
